activity_summary: After Navarre, Augustine Phillips told you that you had been a line behind the ladies. You said the day was in your mind. He said the yard did not laugh, and that Wednesday is the same play.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said the day was in his mind, and that the letter would hold it.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Named the late rhyme and the Wednesday play.

entities.name: Love's Labour's Lost
entities.context: Mentioned in A line behind the ladies

facets.activity: Heard Phillips say the line was behind the ladies

quotes.speaker: augustine_phillips
quotes.text: You were a line behind the ladies.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The day was in my mind.
